entries.title: Isaiah 14:1
segments: ¶For the LORD will have mercy on Jacob, and will still choose Israel, and settle them in their own land. The strangers will be joined with them, and they will cling to the house of Jacob.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:2
segments: Then people will take them and bring them to their place, and the house of Israel will possess them for servants and maids in the land of the LORD; they will take them captive whose captives they were, and rule over their oppressors.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:3
segments: It shall come to pass in the day the LORD gives you rest from your sorrow, and from your fear and the hard bondage in which you were made to serve,

entries.title: Isaiah 14:4
segments: ¶that you will take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say: "How the oppressor has ceased, The golden city ceased!

entries.title: Isaiah 14:5
segments: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, The scepter of the rulers;

entries.title: Isaiah 14:6
segments: He who struck the people in wrath with a continual stroke, He who ruled the nations in anger, Is persecuted [and] no one hinders.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:7
segments: The whole earth is at rest [and] quiet; They break forth into singing.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:8
segments: Indeed the cypress trees rejoice over you, [And] the cedars of Lebanon, [Saying], 'Since you were cut down, No woodsman has come up against us.'

entries.title: Isaiah 14:9
segments: "Hell from beneath is excited about you, To meet [you] at your coming; It stirs up the dead for you, All the chief ones of the earth; It has raised up from their thrones All the kings of the nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:10
segments: They all shall speak and say to you: 'Have you also become as weak as we? Have you become like us?

entries.title: Isaiah 14:11
segments: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, [And] the sound of your stringed instruments; The maggot is spread under you, And worms cover you.'

entries.title: Isaiah 14:12
segments: "How you are fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! [How] you are cut down to the ground, You who weakened the nations!

entries.title: Isaiah 14:13
segments: For you have said in your heart: 'I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God; I will also sit on the mount of the congregation On the farthest sides of the north;

entries.title: Isaiah 14:14
segments: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds, I will be like the Most High.'

entries.title: Isaiah 14:15
segments: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, To the lowest depths of the Pit.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:16
segments: "Those who see you will gaze at you, [And] consider you, [saying: 'Is] this the man who made the earth tremble, Who shook kingdoms,

entries.title: Isaiah 14:17
segments: Who made the world as a wilderness And destroyed its cities, [Who] did not open the house of his prisoners?'

entries.title: Isaiah 14:18
segments: "All the kings of the nations, All of them, sleep in glory, Everyone in his own house;

entries.title: Isaiah 14:19
segments: But you are cast out of your grave Like an abominable branch, [Like] the garment of those who are slain, Thrust through with a sword, Who go down to the stones of the pit, Like a corpse trodden underfoot.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:20
segments: You will not be joined with them in burial, Because you have destroyed your land [And] slain your people. The brood of evildoers shall never be named.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:21
segments: Prepare slaughter for his children Because of the iniquity of their fathers, Lest they rise up and possess the land, And fill the face of the world with cities."

entries.title: Isaiah 14:22
segments: "For I will rise up against them," says the LORD of hosts, "And cut off from Babylon the name and remnant, And offspring and posterity," says the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:23
segments: "I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, And marshes of muddy water; I will sweep it with the broom of destruction," says the LORD of hosts.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:24
segments: ¶The LORD of hosts has sworn, saying, "Surely, as I have thought, so it shall come to pass, And as I have purposed, [so] it shall stand:

entries.title: Isaiah 14:25
segments: That I will break the Assyrian in My land, And on My mountains tread him underfoot. Then his yoke shall be removed from them, And his burden removed from their shoulders.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:26
segments: This [is] the purpose that is purposed against the whole earth, And this [is] the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:27
segments: For the LORD of hosts has purposed, And who will annul [it]? His hand [is] stretched out, And who will turn it back?"

entries.title: Isaiah 14:28
segments: This is the burden which came in the year that King Ahaz died.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:29
segments: "Do not rejoice, all you of Philistia, Because the rod that struck you is broken; For out of the serpent's roots will come forth a viper, And its offspring [will be] a fiery flying serpent.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:30
segments: The firstborn of the poor will feed, And the needy will lie down in safety; I will kill your roots with famine, And it will slay your remnant.

entries.title: Isaiah 14:31
segments: Wail, O gate! Cry, O city! All you of Philistia [are] dissolved; For smoke will come from the north, And no one [will be] alone in his appointed times."

entries.title: Isaiah 14:32
segments: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, And the poor of His people shall take refuge in it.
